About

A little about me

I'm a Full Stack Developer with 1+ year of professional experience building and maintaining production-ready web applications within the .NET ecosystem. I specialize in developing secure RESTful APIs, implementing business logic, and designing efficient data-access layers using Entity Framework and LINQ.

I've contributed to CRM, inventory management, field service management, and healthcare applications, working across both backend and frontend technologies to deliver reliable, scalable solutions. My experience includes authentication and authorization, database integration, CRUD operations, API development, and end-to-end application enhancements.

I follow structured development and testing practices, using NUnit for unit testing and Swagger and Postman for API documentation and validation. I work with Git for version control and use tools such as Excel and Word for technical documentation, reporting, and day-to-day project collaboration.

I'm passionate about learning new technologies, improving application quality, and building clean, maintainable solutions that solve real-world business problems.
